original_title: Avenida Saenz 1073 -video dedicado a la enfermeda de mi padre
overview: Selena Prat visits her childhood home accompanied by Martita, her mother's best friend. The house is now a gym run by Omar Patiño, Selena's Clint Eastwood, a tidy man who has managed to keep the gym running for 40 years, much longer than Selena's family. The protagonists take a tour of the gym and its memories from 1985. The old rooms of the house where the treadmills are now located, the room of Sarita, the grandmother's caregiver, the living room, the patio, the kitchen, and the terrace, which is now the weight room.
title: Avenida Sáenz 1073 - Video dedicated to my father's illness
